|sellprice = 4000 |quality = false }} '''Mapping Cave Systems''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be obtained from a box in the back room of the [[Adventurer's Guild]], which is accessible after killing 1,000 [[monsters]]. It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear). The first reading grants the player a power that gives them a 50% discount on [[Marlon]]'s [[Adventurer's Guild#Item Recovery Service|Item Recovery Service]]. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Combat]] [[Skills|XP]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Penny |like=Elliott |neutral=Abigail,Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leo,Wizard |dislike=Alex }} ==Bundles== Mapping Cave Systems is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Mapping Cave Systems is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used as a dark gray [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Mapping Cave Systems is not used in any [[quests]]. ==References== See Maps\AdventureGuild.tmx in the game files.
